item.title: With method for non record types
item.author: xxxx
item.description: The with keyword in C# allows for the creation of new instances of record types with modified properties. It is however exclusive to record types. This article tries to address that issue.

item.title: Using Records in legacy .NET Frameworks
item.author: xxxx
item.description: C# 9.0 records can be used in older frameworks. Extend your score on records to <sup>100</sup>/<sub>100</sub>
